title: One state, changed by commands
caption: It runs entirely in the browser: screens send commands to a pure domain layer, and CI publishes it on GitHub Pages.

portal.label: Portal
portal.note: For patients or a responsible adult: books on a calendar with the free slots and shows appointments and estimates.

panel.label: Panel
panel.note: Reception, clinicians and management: schedule, messages, waiting list, dental chart, estimates and campaigns. Every change travels as a command.

store.label: DemoStore
store.note: The app's single state: it gives each command a commandId, so a double click books once.

ls.label: localStorage
ls.note: A versioned envelope, validated on hydration: if damaged, it warns and offers a restore; if blocked, the demo runs in memory.

domain.label: Pure domain
domain.note: Each command runs on a copy of the state: if it fails, the copy is discarded and the original stays intact.

clock.label: Clock
clock.note: An injected sample clock: ESLint forbids Date.now and Math.random, so the demo plays out the same every time.

sched.label: Slots
sched.note: Checks the new slot: clinician, chair, site, duration and minimum notice. If it is taken, the original appointment stands.

outbox.label: Outbox
outbox.note: Reminders, offers and campaigns keyed by appointment, version and type: each one exists once and stays in the browser.

audit.label: Audit
audit.note: Records each command with its commandId; reception sees each appointment's audit trail in the panel.
